examined_formations.title: GEO_AI_SEARCH_BRAND_VISIBILITY_CONTROL
examined_formations.chinese_title: AI搜索品牌可见度GEO控制层
examined_formations.evidence_summary: 2026 GEO products already publish monthly, annual, enterprise and performance-based pricing, covering multi-model monitoring, citations, sentiment, competitive analysis, content generation, publishing and reporting.

examined_formations.title: APP_SDK_PRIVACY_COMPLIANCE_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.evidence_summary: 2026 privacy enforcement is active and recurring, but Baidu Springer already sells automated app privacy scanning and app-store compliance packages with explicit per-scan and annual pricing; security vendors also offer deeper remediation services.

examined_formations.title: AIGC_COMMERCIAL_RIGHTS_PROOF_LAYER
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Paid generation platforms already attach commercial-use terms and project authorization evidence to model/API/version/output state. Third-party input, likeness, trademark and platform rights remain fact-specific legal risk rather than a clean neutral machine layer.

examined_formations.title: AI_JOB_APPLICATION_AND_RESUME_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: AI求职投递与简历自动化
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Current tools charge monthly or per-use for resume optimization, ATS matching, form filling and automated applications, while major recruitment platforms are launching their own full-process AI job assistants.

examined_formations.title: SHORT_VIDEO_CONTENT_LABELING_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 短视频内容标注自动化
examined_formations.evidence_summary: 2026 rules make six content labels a publishing requirement across major platforms, while the platforms themselves own label selection, review and correction; current creator-risk tools already provide pre-publish content checks.

examined_formations.title: SOFTWARE_LOCALIZATION_TRANSLATION_AUTOMATION
examined_formations.chinese_title: 软件本地化翻译自动化
examined_formations.evidence_summary: Baidu and Youdao publish current enterprise pricing for team translation, APIs, terminology/knowledge reuse, batch documents, audio/video and private deployment. Localization is a mature paid digital service.
